# Before you begin {#sec-before}

## Intended users

This manual is for clinicians and reviewers using the local review workstation. Dataset export and hospital Model API administration are described only at the level needed to understand the clinician workflow; operator commands are documented separately in the repository deployment guides.

## Scope

Retinal Review Workbench is a clinician-controlled research and clinical-support workstation. It keeps source identity, patient and eye context, human decisions, annotations, model evidence, and export provenance together for review.

It does not autonomously establish a diagnosis, disease truth, referral decision, or treatment decision. The final clinician review remains authoritative.

## Supported input intent

The workstation accepts JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and supported single-frame ophthalmic fundus DICOM. Supported ophthalmic DICOM follows the existing display and provenance path.

MRI, OCT, PACS objects, non-fundus DICOM, unsupported SOP classes, multi-frame objects, and untested transfer syntaxes are outside model support. A recognized non-fundus DICOM is reported as **Unsupported modality**, not as a generic image-read failure.

## Model-assisted evidence

RETFound provides a five-class DR grade suggestion through `retfound-aptos5`. PRISM-DR provides optional lesion suggestions through `prism-dr-5fold`. These outputs assist inspection; they do not replace clinician review.

A displayed confidence or score is a model score, not a calibrated clinical probability. An empty PRISM result does not prove that lesions are absent.

## Workstation areas

| Area | Use |
| --- | --- |
| **Worklist** | Scan cases, review admission status, resolve patient and eye context, and enter a case. |
| **Review** | Inspect the image and optional model assistance. |
| **Clinician Review** | Record the final DR grade or escalate an exception. |
| **Edit Annotations** | Add human annotations or make optional AI ROI class/removal changes. |
| **Datasets** | Inspect task-specific readiness and export the manifest package. |
| **Models & Audit** | Read-only model, inference, hash, and annotation provenance. |
| **Settings** | Select a Workspace, set the default reviewer, and manage next-action hints. |

::: {.callout-warning title="WARNING - human authority"}
Treat every model output as assistive evidence. Do not use a model score or an empty lesion result as a diagnosis, a referral decision, or proof that disease is absent.
:::
